request: Analyze GSE245594 for PMID 38773896 (Combined Endurance and Resistance Exercise Mitigates Age-Associated Cardiac Dysfunction): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (Novogene, Illumina), left ventricle of 22-month-old C57BL/6 male mice (S2.1.p1, S2.2.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: sedentary vs swimming, n = 4 per group (S2.2.p1); the resistance-running arm was not sequenced
final.primary_estimand: Effect of 8-week swimming training versus sedentary on left-ventricle transcript expression in aged (22-month) male mice
planned_contrasts: Swimming vs Sedentary (S2.2.p1, S3.1.p1; paper gives no DE-transcript count)
final.paper_method: Ballgown transcript-level test (linear-model F-test on log2(FPKM+1)), adjusted p (S2.2.p1)
final.secondary_paper_rule: fold-change > 2 and P < 0.05 for heatmap, GO and iRegulon gene sets (S3.1.p1, S3.1.p3, FIG1 E-H); FIG1 C/G/H legends say log2 fold-change > 2 instead
final.paper_results: No DE-transcript count reported. KEGG top-10 down: oxidative phosphorylation, ROS, diabetic cardiomyopathy; GSEA up: cardiac muscle contraction, cGMP-PKG, longevity, mitophagy, mTOR; Usf2 FPKM higher in swimming (FIG5C, t-test P<0.05)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.2.p1 defines the sequenced samples (sedentary vs swimming LV, n=4), the pipeline (StringTie-eB + Ballgown, transcript level) and the DE rule (P-adjust < 0.05, no fold-change cutoff). S2.1.p1 says the swimming cohort was male. The FC>2, P<0.05 lists in S3.1 feed GO/TF analyses and are kept as an audit rule.

checks: DA.p1 names GSE245594 as the deposit of this mRNA-seq
8 GSM samples: 4 Swimming + 4 Sedentary, heart, Mus musculus, matching S2.2.p1 n=4 per group
matrix columns Sed_1-4 / SW_1-4 match the two arms
transcript IDs include StringTie TCONS_ novel transcripts, consistent with the paper's StringTie pipeline

ownership.reasoning: Data availability statement DA.p1 deposits the mRNA-seq as GSE245594; sample counts and arms match S2.2.p1.

alignment.reasoning: The deposited column names (Sed_N, SW_N) do not occur in metadata. prep/prep_matrix.py renamed each column to the GSM whose title has the same arm word and replicate number (title 'Sedentary, bio rep N' -> Sed_N, 'Swimming, bio rep N' -> SW_N); this is a label match, not column order. Alignment is then exact on the GSM index. grp comes from the treatment characteristic.

matrix.reasoning: File name fpkm_mRNA; non-integer values from 0 upward; rows are ENSMUST and TCONS transcript IDs. The paper's input (S2.2.p1) is StringTie-eB FPKM per transcript analysed with Ballgown. GEO data_processing describes STAR/featureCounts/Salmon, which does not match the file; the file content and paper agree on FPKM. No count matrix is deposited.

candidates.reason_rejected: values are non-integer FPKM; no count file deposited

design.reasoning: Two independent groups of aged male mice, swimming vs sedentary (S2.2.p1, S3.1.p1). Single factor; no time, subject or batch column.

covariance.reasoning: Independent animals, randomly assigned (S2.1.p1); metadata records no batch, sex or lane variable that varies across samples.

final.method: limma (moderated t, empirical Bayes) on log2(FPKM+1), transcript level

paper_route.method: Ballgown stattest (transcript FPKM, linear-model F-test, FDR)
paper_route.reason: Ballgown is not an available executor in this repository; the Ballgown input object (ctab files) is not deposited

deviations: limma moderated t replaces the unmoderated Ballgown linear-model F-test on the same log2(FPKM+1) scale; no expression-variance prefilter (paper states none)

method.reasoning: Matrix policy: FPKM -> log2(x+1) then limma. This is the closest validated route to Ballgown, which also fits a linear model on log2(FPKM+1) per transcript.

final.deviation_note: Audit rule is the secondary paper rule FC > 2, P < 0.05 used for gene lists (S3.1.p1, S3.1.p3)

threshold.reasoning: S2.2.p1: transcripts with P-adjust < 0.05 are differentially expressed; no fold-change cutoff. Audit: fold-change > 2 (|log2FC| > 1) and raw P < 0.05 per S3.1.p1/p3.

caveats: paper reports no DE-transcript count to compare
transcript-level IDs; gene-level enrichment not run

study.reasoning: Planned contrast runs on the deposited FPKM with the paper threshold through a declared alternative method.

discrepancies.data: GEO data_processing: STAR, featureCounts, Salmon; deposited file is FPKM with StringTie TCONS IDs

discrepancies.paper: text: fold-change > 2, P < 0.05 (S3.1.p1/p3); FIG1 C/G/H: log2 fold-change > 2

executions.name: grp_SW_vs_SED
executions.reasoning: Planned swimming vs sedentary contrast on log2(FPKM+1).

enrichment.reasoning: Paper reports GO/KEGG/GSEA; rows are transcript IDs (ENSMUST/TCONS), so the runner is expected to record this as not run.
